title: Beyond Named Mechanisms: Economic Institutions as a Design Space for Artificial Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.15017v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multiagent research inherited its economic vocabulary of auctions, markets, prices, bargaining, and matching from a single observed case: human societies. Those institutions bundle identity, competence, execution, ownership, commitment, and settlement in ways that suit agents whose minds are private, who learn rather than copy skills, and who each persist as one person. Engineered agents need not share any of these constraints, making the list of familiar institutions look less like the entirety of economic organization and more like a sample from a larger, unmapped space. We sketch one way to make that space concrete: a provisional chart that records each institution, separately from the agents that run it, as a typed structure over positions, rights and duties, allocation, information, time, state, process, value, and external recognition. In this chart, named institutions become overlapping regions rather than fixed points, neighbor

translated_title: 超越命名机制：作为人工智能体设计空间的经济制度
translated_abstract: 多智能体研究从单一观察对象——人类社会——继承了其经济词汇，包括拍卖、市场、价格、谈判与匹配。这些制度将身份、能力、执行、所有权、承诺与结算捆绑在一起，其方式恰好适合心智彼此私密、通过学习而非复制获得技能、且每个人作为独立个体持续存在的智能体。工程化的人工智能体不必受这些约束，这使得人们熟悉的制度清单看起来不再像经济组织的全部，而更像来自一个更庞大、尚未被描绘的空间的样本。我们勾勒出一种使该空间具体化的方法：绘制一份临时图谱，将每种制度与运行它的智能体分离开来，记录为关于位置、权利与义务、分配、信息、时间、状态、过程、价值以及外部承认的类型化结构。在这份图谱中，命名的制度不再是固定点，而成为相互重叠的区域……
tldr: 本文提出将经济制度视为人工智能体的设计空间，通过一份把制度分解为位置、权利义务、分配、信息等维度的类型化图谱，将拍卖、市场等命名制度重新定位为该空间中相互重叠的区域，从而为设计超越人类社会原有经济形式的人工智能体制度开辟新方向。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes economic institutions as a design space for artificial agents, proposing a typed chart that decomposes institutions into dimensions such as positions, rights and duties, allocation, and information—revealing familiar mechanisms like auctions and markets as merely overlapping regions within a larger, unmapped space of possibilities.
